expected_level_description: You can: - act as the escalation point and resolve large or high risk commercial management issues - coach others in appropriate commercial management

You can: - develop and own a business case and iterate it throughout the life cycle - coach others on identifying benefits whilst balancing user and business needs - communicate the delivery of incremental value - build the case for an organisational approach to value through product strategy - coach and empower teams to take a value for money approach
You can: - interpret new procurement rules and lead the organisation's response - advise the board on procurement compliance and risk - manage formal challenges with legal advisers
You can: - set the organisation's supplier relationship strategy - lead executive relationships with strategic suppliers - lead the response when a critical supplier fails
You can: - set the organisation's social value and sustainable procurement policy - report social value and carbon outcomes to the board

You can: - change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs - lead on the strategy for the whole organisation, marrying business needs with innovative analysis - make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity - build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders - solve and unblock issues between teams or departments at the highest level - understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills - coach the organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution
You can: - influence or create complex budgets across an organisation, programme or product view - manage the budget you are given and make it work
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - design the governance framework and advise the board - lead annual governance reporting and assurance
You can: - design the organisation's risk management framework and appetite - advise the board on strategic risks
